Command-Line Reference > Environment Variables

Environment Variables

Sla command-line behavior is affected by several environment variables: plugin development mode, standard library location, delegation target selection, and diagnostic switches. After reading this page you can troubleshoot on your own when installation is abnormal or sa_std cannot be found.

Core variables

VariableEffect
SA_PLUGIN_DEVEnables plugin development mode; takes effect with the value 1 or true. A plugin installed via sa plugin install --dev requires running in this mode; all sa sla ... examples in the README carry this prefix.
SA_STD_DIRThe sa_std standard library root directory. Sla gives it priority when resolving @import "sa_std/..." and loading std contracts (the directory counts as valid only if it contains files such as core/sa_core.sa, io/print.sai, etc.).
NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePathWindows-specific. When set to 1, cmd.exe refuses to resolve executables / batch files from the current directory, and reports “not recognized as an internal or external command” even when the file is right there. Some development sessions carry this variable by default; clear it before running a locally built sa.exe / sla.exe.

Delegation and path resolution

VariableEffect
SA_EXEExplicitly specifies the path of the delegated host sa executable, with the highest priority.
SCI_ROOTThe root directory of the local sci checkout. Used to find $SCI_ROOT/zig-out/bin/sa(.exe) and the fallback $SCI_ROOT/sa_std standard library.

The complete resolution order for sa_std (tried in sequence, taking the first that passes validation):

  1. The standard library directory built into the plugin's configuration at compile time;
  2. SA_STD_DIR;
  3. $SCI_ROOT/sa_std;
  4. $HOME/projects/sci/sa_std (on Windows, USERPROFILE is read);
  5. $HOME/.sa/std;
  6. A set of relative-location candidates (such as sa_std, sci/sa_std, ../sci/sa_std, etc.).

Diagnostic and debugging switches

VariableEffect
SLA_PROFILEWhen set to a non-empty value other than 0/false, commands such as check output per-stage timings to stderr: [sla-profile] check parse: 12ms.
SLA_PROFILE_CONTRACTSA fine-grained timing switch for the contract loading stage, with the same value rules as above.
SLA_SAB_NO_FALLBACKA historical strict switch: the SA compatibility fallback was removed on 2026-09-28 and there is now no fallback by default; SAB is sealed, so this variable is meaningful only for the no-fallback sweep of an explicitly selected SAB path.
SLA_KEEP_TEST_SAAfter a --test-backend sa run, the generated .test.sa is deleted by default; setting this variable (to a non-empty value other than 0/false/no) keeps that intermediate artifact for inspection.

Troubleshooting examples

# PowerShell：本地构建的 sa.exe 无法直接运行时
$env:NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath = $null

# 指定本地新构建的宿主与标准库
$env:SA_PLUGIN_DEV = "1"
$env:SA_EXE      = "D:\projects\sla\sci\zig-out\bin\sa.exe"
$env:SA_STD_DIR  = "D:\projects\sla\sci\sa_std"
sa sla build-exe src\main.sla -o bin\app.exe

# Git Bash 等价写法
export SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1
export SA_STD_DIR=$HOME/projects/sci/sa_std
sa sla check src/main.sla
NoteThe concrete drive-letter paths in the examples are only demonstrations of the syntax; replace them with the actual locations of sci / sa_std on your machine. When SA_EXE and SCI_ROOT are not set, it falls back to the globally installed sa.
